en.t: Unable to return to the dream, he felt deeply sorrowful.

units.source_text: 次日一早起身，不说原由，只管吩咐各处寺院诵经礼忏。

en.t: Early the next morning he rose, gave no reason, and simply ordered temples everywhere to recite sutras and perform rites of repentance.

units.source_text: 他想：“梦见她恨我，说‘教我在阴间痛苦’，想来事实确是如此。

en.t: He thought, "In the dream she hated me and said, 'You made me suffer in the underworld'; thinking about it, that must indeed be the truth.

units.source_text: 她生前勤修佛法，其他一切罪孽都已消除，只有这一件事，使她在这世间染上了污浊，无法洗刷。”

en.t: During her lifetime she diligently practiced the Buddhist way, and all her other sins had been erased; only this one matter stained her with worldly defilement that could not be washed away."

units.source_text: 他想象藤壶母后来世受苦之状，心中更觉悲伤。

en.t: Imagining Empress Fujitsubo suffering in the world to come, he felt still greater sorrow in his heart.

units.source_text: 便仔细考虑：有何办法可到这渺茫的幽冥界中去找到她而代她受罪呢？

en.t: He then pondered carefully: was there any way to go into that vast, uncertain realm of the dead, find her, and suffer punishment in her place?

units.source_text: 然而公然为藤壶母后举办法事，又恐引起世人议论。

en.t: Yet if he openly held memorial rites for Empress Fujitsubo, he feared it would provoke talk among the people.

units.source_text: 况且冷泉帝正在烦恼，闻知了得不怀疑？

en.t: Moreover, Emperor Reizei was already troubled; if he heard of it, how could he fail to become suspicious?

units.source_text: 于是只得专心祷祝阿弥陀佛，祈求往生极乐世界，与藤壶母后同坐莲台。

en.t: So he could only pray single-mindedly to Amida Buddha, begging to be reborn in the Pure Land and sit with Empress Fujitsubo upon the same lotus throne.
